# bob props

Show and edit frontmatter properties for one note

```text title="bob props --help"
Show and edit frontmatter properties for one note

Bare `bob props` prints this help. show reads one note's ordered properties. update applies a fingerprinted property envelope under the vault lock.

Usage: bob props <COMMAND>

Commands:
  show    Show ordered frontmatter properties for one note
  update  Apply a guarded property edit to one note

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Bare `bob props` prints this help. show reads one note's ordered properties. update applies a fingerprinted property envelope under the vault lock.

Examples:
  bob props show notes/groceries.md
  bob props show eat/ninja -f json
  bob props update notes/groceries.md -i update.json -f json
  bob props update eat/ninja -i - -d -f json < preview.json

See docs/props.md for the envelope, operations, Undo, and JSON.
Run 'bob props <command> --help' for more information on a command.
```

## bob props show

Show ordered frontmatter properties for one note

```text title="bob props show --help"
Show the ordered frontmatter properties for one vault note: source order, line numbers, typed values, kinds, styles, and the owning card or writer for each key, plus the semantic fingerprint. Area and project notes also report the settings contract (stage, choices, declared and effective values, and ^prj facts). NOTE is a vault-relative Markdown path (the `.md` suffix is optional) or an absolute Markdown path inside the vault. Damaged YAML still reports its recovery state. The command is read-only. See docs/props.md for the report contract and kind/style rules.

Usage: bob props show [OPTIONS] <NOTE>

Arguments:
  <NOTE>
          Vault-relative Markdown path (`.md` optional) or absolute Markdown path inside the vault

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: text or json

          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob props show notes/groceries.md
  bob props show eat/ninja -f json
  bob props show 2026/20261122 -f json

Environment:
  BOB_DIR          Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  NO_COLOR         Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  report
  1  vault I/O failure
  2  bad note path, missing note, or non-Markdown target

See docs/props.md for the report contract and kind/style rules.
```

## bob props update

Apply a guarded property edit to one note

```text title="bob props update --help"
Apply a guarded JSON envelope of prop.set, prop.unset, prop.rename, prop.move, prop.set_yaml, prop.restore, setting.set, and setting.clear operations to one vault note's frontmatter. The envelope carries a semantic fingerprint in `expect`; Bob re-reads the note under the vault lock and replans against those fresh bytes, preserving unrelated body and formatting edits. Use --dry-run to preview the candidate, fingerprints, inverse ops, frontmatter diff, setting effects, and the candidate settings contract without writing. Owned keys stay read-only here. See docs/props.md for the envelope, operations, undo, and JSON.

Usage: bob props update [OPTIONS] --input <FILE> <NOTE>

Arguments:
  <NOTE>
          Vault-relative Markdown path (`.md` optional) or absolute Markdown path inside the vault

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -d, --dry-run
          Preview the plan without writing files

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: text or json

          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -i, --input <FILE>
          Guarded JSON envelope file, or - for stdin

Examples:
  bob props update notes/groceries.md -i update.json -f json
  bob props update eat/ninja -i - -d -f json < preview.json
  bob props update 2026/20261122 -i undo.json

Environment:
  BOB_DIR                   Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  BOB_VAULT_SYNC_LOCK_FILE  Maintenance lock; defaults to ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/bob_sync.lock
  NO_COLOR                  Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  0  previewed or updated
  1  vault I/O, lock busy, or stale guarded write
  2  usage, invalid envelope, or refused operation

See docs/props.md for the envelope, operations, Undo, and JSON.
```
